candidates.label: Exclusion of the poor answered by total deprivation and collective repentance
candidates.definition: In 68:24-32: Saying there will surely not enter it today upon you any poor person; and they went early in determination assuming themselves able; but when they saw it they said indeed we are lost, rather we have been deprived; the most moderate said did I not say to you why do you not exalt Allah; they said exalted is our Lord indeed we were wrongdoers; then they approached one another blaming each other; they said O woe to us indeed we were transgressors; perhaps our Lord will substitute for us one better than it indeed we are toward our Lord desirous.

candidates.label: Yunus's distress and rescue as patience model for the Prophet
